name: TheReader.AI – Automated News Feeds, AI Content & SEO Booster
author: candominds

sections.description:
TheReader.AI is a news curation and automation tool that connects your WordPress site to the TheReader.AI cloud service. It allows site owners to display curated news headlines and AI-generated summaries tailored to specific industries or custom niche topics.

💡 Service Tiers

The plugin requires an API key to connect to the TheReader.AI service. We offer two levels of access:
* Standard Mode (Free): Fetch summarized news from general categories (e.g., Technology, Sports, Business). This is available at no cost after generating a free API key.
* AI Custom News (Premium): Provides targeted news curation for specific niches or custom prompts (e.g., “Real Estate trends in Bangalore”). This tier requires a paid subscription to cover the high-resource AI processing costs.

🚀 Core Features:

  • Context-Aware Summaries: Our service processes full-length articles into concise bullet points relevant to your selected niche or category.
  • Source Transparency: Every news card includes the original publisher’s name and a direct link to the source article for full attribution.
  • Structured Data: Automatically injects JSON-LD NewsArticle schema to signal content freshness to search engines.
  • Automated Refresh: Uses WP-Cron to update your feed automatically based on your preferred frequency.

🔒 Privacy & Service Disclosure

This plugin is “Service-ware” and requires a connection to the TheReader.AI API.
* External Service: TheReader.AI (https://thereader.ai)
* Functionality: The external service handles global news monitoring, niche filtering, and AI summarization.
* Data Transmission: The plugin sends your API key and niche configuration (categories or custom prompt) to our servers to retrieve relevant data.
* Privacy: No personal user data or WordPress database information is shared with the external service.
* Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  3. Get your API Key: Visit TheReader.AI to register or log in.
  4. Navigate to TheReader.AI in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  5. Enter your API key and click Verify.
  6. Select a Standard Category (Free) or enter a Custom Niche (Premium).
  7. Use the [thereader_news] shortcode on any page or post to display the feed.
sections.faq:
Is there a cost to use this plugin?

The plugin itself and the “Standard Mode” (general category news) are free to use after registering for an API key. The “AI Custom News” feature, which provides hyper-targeted niche curation, requires a paid subscription.

Why does “AI Custom News” cost money?

Unlike general categories, custom niche requests require our servers to perform real-time AI filtering and summarization on a per-request basis across 50,000+ sources, which involves significant computing costs.

Where do I get my API key?

You can generate both free and premium keys at thereader.ai/api-integration.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Maintenance: Verified sync workflow and stabilized plugin action links.

1.1.0

  • UI Enhancement: Added convenient ‘Settings’ and ‘Go Premium’ quick links directly to the Plugins page action row.

1.0.9

  • Feature: Automatically purge frontend cache mechanisms (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, Elementor, W3, SG Optimizer, etc.) after a successful news sync so that the new headlines are immediately visible to site visitors, even on heavily cached sites.

1.0.8

  • Bugfix: Fixed an issue where WP-Cron schedules might drop due to third-party conflict.
  • Feature: Added Last Sync Time and Status logging to the admin dashboard for easier debugging.

1.0.7

  • Security: Implemented nonce verification and input sanitization.
  • Compliance: Renamed functions and options with tread_ prefix.
  • Feature: Distinguished between Free (Standard) and Premium (Custom Niche) service tiers.
  • Feature: Enhanced JSON-LD metadata injection.
  • Documentation: Updated Service Disclosure per Guideline 6.
